        dots = np.dot(accepted_mat[:count], p_new)
        
        if np.all(dots <= 2):
            accepted_mat[count] = p_new
            count += 1
            
            # Safety break if we exceed pre-allocated space (unlikely for 11D)
            if count >= 1000:
                break
                
    # Return result as int64 as per standard requirements
    return accepted_mat[:count].astype(np.int64)
